verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code SDK for TypeScript, Python and Go. Its docs say v4 has no autonomous loop, so developers write the orchestration themselves, sequencing act/observe/extract calls with typed, schema-validated outputs. Repeatability is supported by caching, self-healing selectors, and turning agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of loops, conditionals and parameterized workflow patterns (these are implied by host-language code rather than shown), and independent hands-on corroboration of repeatable multi-step workflows.
